_preset: Noisy VHS — loose thresholds for degraded and unstable tape
_description: For tapes with worn-out black slugs, heavy noise, colour bleed into transitions, or irregular recording levels. Loosens all thresholds and adds asymmetric trim to recover content that tight boundaries would clip. Disable require_div5 — VHS timing is never exact. Expect more false-positive candidates; review dataset.jsonl confidence scores and raise min-commercial if needed.
_group_black: Black frame detection — permissive for noisy tape
_group_advanced: Advanced detection — loosened for analog noise

_tuning_notes.pixTh_raised: 0.08 → 0.12: analog black slugs are never truly black; more pixels pass threshold
_tuning_notes.picTh_lowered: 0.98 → 0.92: VHS noise prevents 98% of pixels being 'black'; 92% is realistic
_tuning_notes.mergeGap_raised: 1.5 → 2.5s: VHS slugs often flicker or have dropout gaps mid-boundary
_tuning_notes.uniformMaxStddev_raised: 8 → 14: noisy black has higher stddev than clean digital black
_tuning_notes.silenceNoiseDb_raised: -40 → -35 dB: VHS audio floor is noisier; -40 may miss real silence
_tuning_notes.sceneThreshold_lowered: 0.40 → 0.35: catches softer cuts and dissolves common in analog editing
_tuning_notes.removeBefore_nonzero: 0.1s: recovers content clipped by ambiguous slug entry points
_tuning_notes.removeAfter_nonzero: 0.05s: trims the tail of black that sometimes bleeds into ad content
_tuning_notes.includeBlack_true: Include surrounding slugs in commercial clips for archival completeness
_tuning_notes.dryRun_true: Always dry-run first on noisy sources before committing to cuts

_signals_expected: uniform_overlap (less frequent than clean tape — slugs too noisy)
